title: Harden CI video fixture generation

context.summary: Fix GitHub CI failure in the integration video fixture generator.
context.background: After TASK-114 fixed pnpm setup, GitHub CI reached pnpm check and failed while generating the MP4 fixture with ffmpeg on ubuntu-latest.

in: Make the integration video fixture generation tolerate ffmpeg builds without libx264.
Keep the fixture as a real video consumed by the existing ffmpeg extraction path.
Validate tasks and repository checks before merge.
out: Changing release signing or GitHub repository settings.

acceptance_criteria: The video integration fixture can be generated with libx264 or the built-in mpeg4 encoder.
The worker video ffmpeg extraction path remains covered by pnpm test.
Task registry includes TASK-115 and validates.
pnpm check passes locally before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm the GitHub CI failure was in buildFfmpegVideoFixture.

risks: GitHub release may reveal a later publishing-only issue after CI checks pass.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
